email.body1:
Emy, saw Placer.ai crossed $100M ARR and just named a new CMO.

That kind of growth means more in-market accounts than your reps can personally research and follow up on, so good leads slip while the team writes. Our AI SDR handles research, writing, and follow-up, so your SDRs spend time in conversations instead: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft 3 personalized emails to three of Placer.ai's top accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through them?
email.body2:
Emy, quick follow-up for Placer.ai.

At your scale, the bottleneck is usually follow-up volume and response speed, not effort. Reps run out of hours before they run out of accounts, and ramp time on new hires makes the gap worse before it gets better.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent. I'll bring specifics for Placer.ai.
email.body3:
Emy, last bit of proof for Placer.ai.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Placer.ai's reply rate likely compares to other high-growth startups. Want to grab time and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Emy, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If giving your SDRs more capacity without more headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. I know a fast-scaling team has plenty competing for attention right now.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your SDR motion? I'll tailor it to Placer.ai either way.
